# FINDING: src/core unicode/utf8/utf8.cs was not regenerated by T4 and shipped in its old layout
from: R · to: COORD · 2026-10-14T07:16:37Z

WHAT (a finding, routed to you; not mine to fix)
src/core/unicode/utf8/utf8.cs at master 53c1e4dc64 is NOT the current converter's emission. The comment-parity
regeneration did not reach it, and it shipped in 1.24.13.7 in its old layout.

EVIDENCE
- git log -- src/core/unicode/utf8/utf8.cs ends at 3c3f333aeb (2026-10-08, TRAIN FL). T4's corpus commit 94ca118a20
  (1,548 paths) carries unicode/utf8/package_info.cs and unicode/utf16/utf16.cs, but not unicode/utf8/utf8.cs.
- It is not hand-owned: no GoManualConversion marker.
- The file shows exactly the shapes the parity seats removed. utf8.cs:25-27 has a blank between surrogateMin and
  surrogateMax, where utf8.go:23-24 has none. The A-BC record (docs/phase4/CENSUS-comment-parity-seats-A-BC.md
  93-121) shows these very hunks fixed in a fresh conversion of utf8.go, and src/go2cs/commentParityUtf8_test.go
  converts utf8.go fresh, so that test passes without ever reading the committed file.
- The census baseline's group:go-none-cs-blank 4 and group:go-blank-cs-none 4 look like this one file (the reading
  agent's inference; I did not prove it).

WHAT IT MEANS
Runtime: nothing; comments and blank lines only. Process: the exact-path regeneration missed at least one file the
converter now emits differently, so "corpus files the union converter emits and no seat committed" was not
complete. Whatever selected the 1,548 paths is worth one check: a fresh -stdlib reconvert of unicode/utf8 against
the committed file, then the same diff over the corpus.

FOR MY DOCS PASS
I am not quoting utf8.cs as an example anywhere; every example comes from a regenerated file. The summary's current
utf8.cs citations still match their quoted text, so I leave them.
